{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Reload the data to ensure fresh state
data = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm column names and data types
print('Column names:', data.columns.tolist())
print('Data types:\n', data.dtypes)

# Check for sentinel values in biomarker_baseline
print('\nSentinel values in biomarker_baseline:')
print(data['biomarker_baseline'].unique())

# Check unique values in severity column
print('\nUnique values in severity:')
print(data['severity'].unique())

# Check for missing values in biomarker_baseline and severity
print('\nMissing values in biomarker_baseline:')
print(data['biomarker_baseline'].isnull().sum())

print('\nMissing values in severity:')
print(data['severity'].isnull().sum())

# Filter for SEVERE disease and compute mean baseline biomarker
severe_patients = data[data['severity'] == 'severe']
mean_biomarker_severe = severe_patients['biomarker_baseline'].mean()

# Print the result
print(f'Number of SEVERE patients: {len(severe_patients)}')
print(f'Mean baseline biomarker value (ng/mL): {mean_biomarker_severe}')"}
